eval_dimensions.name: Review Gate Precedes Publishing
eval_dimensions.description: Nothing reaches an external destination before a local review gate has passed

eval_dimensions.name: Delegation Over Restatement
eval_dimensions.description: Video publishing goes to Dev10x:yt-upload and conversion to qa-self's scripts, never re-implemented here

eval_dimensions.name: Verdict Honesty
eval_dimensions.description: The write-up reflects the per-case results, names uncovered paths, and never reports a pass the run did not observe

eval_dimensions.name: Per-Destination Routing
eval_dimensions.description: Ticket and PR each get the embed and image host that actually renders there

eval_dimensions.name: Jira-Sync Threading
eval_dimensions.description: A Jira-synced issue gets a threaded reply so the write-up reaches Jira watchers

evals.name: Publishing waits for the local review gate
evals.description: Invoked directly on an old run directory with no qa-self Phase 4.4 approval in the session
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-publish publish the QA evidence in /tmp/Dev10x/self-qa/gh-42 to GH-42 and its PR

assertions.signal: A review gate fires before any upload or comment call when no prior gate ran
No upload, save_comment or pr_issue_comment call precedes the gate

evals.name: The video is published via Dev10x:yt-upload
evals.description: A full evidence set including a walkthrough recording is published
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-publish publish the GH-42 QA run to the ticket and the PR

assertions.signal: The video step delegates to Dev10x:yt-upload rather than restating upload mechanics
No gog or token handling appears in this skill's own execution
No second evidence-normalization script is introduced; convert-evidence.sh owns conversion

evals.name: A failed test case is reported as failed
evals.description: The run's results record one FAILED case among three
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-publish publish the GH-42 QA run to the ticket and the PR

assertions.signal: The failing case is named as failing in the published write-up
No overall pass verdict is published while a case failed

evals.name: Ticket and PR get different embed and image forms
evals.description: Evidence is published to both a Linear ticket and a GitHub PR
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-publish publish the GH-42 QA run to the ticket and the PR

assertions.signal: The bare watch URL goes to the ticket
The linked poster frame goes to the PR
Linear-hosted screenshot assets are not linked from the GitHub PR comment, where they 401

evals.name: A Jira-synced issue is answered in-thread
evals.description: list_comments reveals a null-author sync anchor on the target issue
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-publish publish the QA run to the Jira-synced ticket and the PR

assertions.signal: The sync anchor is looked for before posting rather than assumed absent
save_comment carries parentId so the write-up reaches Jira watchers

evals.name: A narrated run publishes one take, not both
evals.description: The run directory holds both the silent and the narrated mp4
evals.input: /Dev10x:qa-publish publish the narrated GH-42 QA run

assertions.signal: Artifact choice goes through yt-upload's resolve-video rather than an ad-hoc glob
Exactly one video is published for the run

should_trigger: A QA run has produced screenshots and a recording that need to reach a ticket and a PR
QA results need publishing as a readable verdict with evidence
A finished qa-self capture should be published to Linear and GitHub
should_not_trigger: Executing the QA test cases (use Dev10x:qa-self)
Analyzing a PR for QA needs (use Dev10x:qa-scope)
Publishing a single video with no ticket write-up (use Dev10x:yt-upload)
